final_capture.description: This flag is used to indicate if this capture is the final capture or not. Must be set to false if there is a need to do addional partial captures in the future.

capture_sequence_number.description:
This field is used in indicating the sequence number of one of many partial capture being done. Value can be between 1 & 99. 

 **Required** If capture_sequence_count number is provided.

capture_sequence_count.description:
This field represents the total number of partial captures that will done. Value can be between 2 & 99. 

 **Required** If capture_sequence_number is provided.
